articles.title: India starts tokenizing $620 billion corporate bond market with digital rupee settlement
articles.snippet: SEBI’s Demat 2.0 pilot turns corporate bonds into digital tokens and settles payment through the RBI’s wholesale digital rupee, with secondary trading and retail access expected in later phases.

articles.title: Polymarket names former Amazon finance chief Warren Jenson as its first CFO
articles.snippet: Jenson becomes the prediction market’s first CFO as Polymarket builds its regulated U.S. exchange and global platform.

articles.title: Trading stocks against BONER is the latest trend for DeFi degens
articles.snippet: Why would anyone want to trade a healthcare stock for a memecoin like BONER? Why wouldn’t they, ask the degens on Robinhood Chain who are building a strange new corner of DeFi.

articles.title: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC
articles.snippet: Blockstream said it would work with law enforcement, exchanges and forensic specialists to recover the Bitcoin if the hackers do not return it.

articles.title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
articles.snippet: Memecoin platform Pump.fun accounted for most of the new tokens among launchpads, as the Solana network notched a new all-time daily issuance high.
